run.schema_text:
Database: sales_db

Table: customers
- id integer
- name character varying
- country character varying
Table: order_items
- id integer
- order_id integer
- product_id integer
- quantity integer
Table: orders
- id integer
- customer_id integer
- order_date date
Table: products
- id integer
- name character varying
- category character varying
- price numeric

Relationships:
- order_items.order_id -> orders.id
- order_items.product_id -> products.id
- orders.customer_id -> customers.id

results.question: Which product sold the most units?
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 1;

GROUP BY p.id
ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC
LIMIT 1;
